title: Omoluabi News Entry
description: One entry in _data/news.json. `status` is the human-governed editorial-publication boundary: only "published" and "example" entries may ever be rendered into the public feed (see docs/decisions/003-sandbox-publication-boundary.md and _js/main.js's renderNewsFeed filter).

status.description: draft: being written, not committed as ready. sandbox: reasoning/testing content held for exploration, never renders publicly. published: real reporting, cleared for the public feed. example: demonstration content, cleared for the public feed but must render an example notice. retracted: was published, no longer stands, kept visible with a correction notice rather than silently deleted. Only published and example ever appear in the rendered feed.
